title: Whole Forked Notched Thallus and Circular Gemma Cups Liverwort
description: One wholly newly authored static vegetative liverwort form at approximately six-centimetre natural patch scale. All thallus boundary, branching height field, cup profiles and gemma coordinates are new, not flattened old leaves, a repaired held plant, a pore-count variant of the epidermis patch or a recoloured bowl. One complete opaque nature prop, zero scenes, four subdued green and lower-surface PBR roles.
